title: NSA source at collusion meetings with a tech company

tellings.quote: I have a guy who is with NSA who was in meetings with some of the senior seuite people at a major tech and telecommunications company sort of colluding

plain: A man working for the NSA, the US agency that intercepts communications, sat in meetings with senior executives of a major tech and telecommunications company where, in effect, the two sides were colluding. Steven Greer, a UFO researcher and activist, says this man is his source and relays what he was told. Greer offers it as a sign that government secrecy reaches into private industry.
